basic_info.description: Beautiful 3 level, 4BDR/2.5BA home with extra family room /guest space, views, expansive decks and west facing garden oasis, just steps to Noe's parks, and 24th St's village! Light filled LR lined w windows and a punctuated by a w/b fireplace. Spacious FDR w beautiful stained glass opens to the LR and allows access to the kitchen, as well - the perfect entertaining flow! Remodeled pro kitchen w ample work and storage space, stainless appliances, quartz counters, marble tile backsplash, farmhouse porcelain sink, new cabinetry, Viking range, and a breakfast bar. Kitchen opens to an expansive deck and lush, west facing backyard on the ~2500 square foot lot. Two spacious BDRs and a sleek powder rm complete the main level. Upstairs, a light filled principal suite opens with French doors to a massive, private, sun drenched deck w City and Bay views, relax and enjoy your morning coffee while taking in the view! A walk-in closet, potential laundry space, a tiled en suite bath, and a 4th BDR w Twin Peaks views complete the top level. On the lower level, ~600sft of extra space opening to its own sun-filled deck- perfect for guests, au pair, family room, home office. SUV Garage or 2 cars sxs w storage. 6 zone audio, structural, electrical and plumbing updates. Walker's paradise! Wow.
